categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing of lens modules, SMD LED derivative environmental sensors, high-power industrial power supply thick copper products, POWER IC copper substrates, high-speed transmission products, and specialized automotive products. It focuses on advanced product development and market expansion in these segments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes innovative lens module technology, SMD LED technology, thick copper manufacturing for power supplies, and advanced copper substrate fabrication for POWER ICs. It emphasizes process management to improve product quality and cost control, with ongoing R&D in high-speed transmission and specialized automotive applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial clients requiring high-power power supplies, automotive manufacturers needing specialized components, and electronics companies utilizing lens modules and LED sensors. The company targets global markets with a focus on high-end product segments to enhance profitability and competitiveness.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main production base is in Kunshan, China, with a monthly capacity of approximately 1.4 million square feet. It serves global markets, leveraging its manufacturing footprint in mainland China to access international customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying advanced electronic components such as lens modules, LED sensors, and copper substrates to downstream customers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening operational efficiency, strict cost control, enhancing process management, and improving product quality. R&D efforts focus on developing high-end products, innovating lens modules, SMD LED sensors, thick copper power supplies, POWER IC substrates, and high-speed transmission technologies to enter new markets and increase market competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of electronic components and modules, including lens modules, LED sensors, power supply products, and automotive specialty products. The company emphasizes expanding sales volume and entering high-value product markets to improve profitability.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a technology-driven manufacturer with a focus on high-end and specialized electronic components. It aims to enhance its market competitiveness through innovation and quality improvements to differentiate from peers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the reported fiscal year, the company recorded operating revenue of approximately NT$5.1 billion, a decrease of 14.38% from the previous year. Despite a decline in gross profit, net profit improved significantly to NT$147.97 million, reflecting a positive growth trajectory in profitability. The company maintains a stable financial structure with a debt-to-asset ratio of 48.43% and shows improving return on assets and equity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering innovative, high-quality electronic components with advanced technologies such as thick copper substrates and environmental sensing LEDs. Its value proposition lies in superior product quality, process control, and the development of specialized products that meet evolving customer needs in industrial and automotive sectors, thereby enhancing customer satisfaction and long-term partnerships.
